description: This file contains low-level ADC (Analog to Digital Converter) configuration, initialization, and data acquisition functions for a firmware project. It manages multiple ADC channels, supports slow and fast sampling modes, handles ADC callbacks, and interfaces with hardware pins and PWM for triggering conversions.

classes.name: AdcDevice
classes.description: Represents an ADC hardware device, managing its configuration, channels, and data buffer.

methods.name: AdcDevice::AdcDevice
methods.description: Constructor initializing the ADC device with hardware configuration.

methods.name: AdcDevice::size
methods.description: Returns the number of channels configured for this ADC device.

methods.name: AdcDevice::getAdcValueByHwChannel
methods.description: Returns the latest ADC reading for a specific hardware channel.

methods.name: AdcDevice::getAdcValueByIndex
methods.description: Returns the ADC value stored at a specific internal buffer index.

methods.name: AdcDevice::init
methods.description: Initializes the ADC configuration for the device.

methods.name: AdcDevice::isHwUsed
methods.description: Checks if a specific hardware ADC channel is used by this device.

methods.name: AdcDevice::enableChannel
methods.description: Enables a specific hardware ADC channel for sampling.

methods.name: AdcDevice::enableChannelAndPin
methods.description: Enables a channel and initializes the corresponding hardware pin.

methods.name: AdcDevice::getAdcHardwareIndexByInternalIndex
methods.description: Returns hardware index from internal buffer index.
